# Version 4.150.6 (Unreleased)
> **GPU failure handling**

## Highlights

This update strengthens Ganesh flush reporting and GPU buffer-upload checks on the m150 line.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Ganesh flush status** — Separates whether a render task ran from whether it succeeded, correcting native success reporting after task execution or GPU submission fails. ([#5258](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5258))
- **GPU upload failure checks** — Adds Ganesh buffer-upload checks under memory pressure to reject failed initialization and propagate checked upload failures rather than drawing stale data. CPU triangulation data is retained for retry; this is not complete upload-failure coverage. ([#5323](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5323))
